item.title: Pineville police warn residents of fake DMV text message scam
item.description: The Pineville Police Department is warning residents about fraudulent text messages claiming to be from the Louisiana DMV regarding “outstanding traffic tickets” and threatening license suspension, registration termination, fines, or credit impacts. Officials said the messages are a scam, often containing suspicious links and urging immediate payment. Residents are advised not to click the links … Continue reading Pineville police warn residents of fake DMV text message scam

item.title: Pineville police lieutenant retires after 28 years of service
item.description: The Pineville Police Department is recognizing Lt. Kevin Sweeney following his retirement after 28 years in law enforcement. Throughout his career, Sweeney served in multiple roles within the department, including patrol officer, detective, patrol sergeant, patrol lieutenant and administrative lieutenant. Department officials said his career reflected steady leadership and a commitment to serving the community. … Continue reading Pineville police lieutenant retires after 28 years of service
